situation: 2 years at a logistics startup. When my lead left in March I took over warehouse scheduling and cut overtime by about $40k. I'm on $72k, the market for this role looks like $85k. Need to message my manager Kevin on Slack to set up the talk.
reply: Hi Kevin, could we set aside 30 minutes next week to talk about my role and compensation? The scope has grown a lot since I took over warehouse scheduling in March, and I'd like to give it proper time rather than squeeze it into our Thursday 1:1. Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon both work for me.
note: Book first, ask in the room: bring the $40k overtime saving and the $85k figure to the meeting, not to Slack.

situation: Hatte heute mein Gespräch mit meiner Chefin Frau Albers wegen der Beförderung zur Teamleiterin. Sie will das mit dem Geschäftsführer Herrn Brandt besprechen, hat aber kein Datum genannt. Ich will eine Follow-up-Mail schreiben.
reply: Liebe Frau Albers, vielen Dank für das offene Gespräch heute. Zur Bestätigung: Sie besprechen die Beförderung zur Teamleiterin zum 1. Januar mit Herrn Brandt und geben mir bis zum 30. Oktober Bescheid. Bis Freitag schicke ich Ihnen noch die Übersicht zur Einarbeitung der drei neuen Kolleginnen, falls sie für das Gespräch hilft. Viele Grüße, Jana Keller
note: Das Datum für die Antwort steht in der Mail, auch wenn es im Gespräch gefehlt hat.

situation: My manager said no raise this year because of the hiring freeze. I asked for 8% after leading the checkout redesign. I'm a UX designer and I don't want to just drop it.
reply: Understood, and thanks for being straight with me about the freeze. While salary is fixed, could we move me to the senior designer title now, since I've been leading the checkout redesign, and put the 8% first in line for the January review? I'll add a note to both our calendars for 15 January.
note: Trade a lever that costs no budget now, and lock in a date for the money.

situation: My company just published salary bands. I'm a senior analyst on $68,000 and the band for my level is $74,000 to $88,000. I lead the pricing model now. Want to raise it with my manager Laura without sounding accusatory.
reply: Hi Laura, now that the pay bands are published, I noticed my salary of $68,000 sits below the $74,000 to $88,000 band for senior analyst. I'd like to understand how my pay was set, and whether we can bring it to $78,000, given I now own the pricing model. Could we find 30 minutes next week to talk it through? Thursday or Friday afternoon both work.
note: Anchor on the published band and your scope, never on a colleague's pay, and name the number you want.

situation: 我在一家跨境电商公司做数据分析三年，月薪1.8万。上周拿到另一家公司2.4万的offer，要在10月12号前回复。我其实更想留下，想跟领导王姐谈加薪，怎么提这个offer才不像威胁？
reply: 王姐，我很喜欢现在的工作，也想在这个团队长期做下去。过去一年我搭了广告投放的归因看板，投放组的获客成本降了大约15%，新人的数据培训现在也是我在带。坦白说，上周我拿到了另一家公司月薪2.4万的offer，但我更想留下，所以想先跟您谈：能不能把我的月薪调到2.3万？需要什么材料去跟张总申请，我这周都可以准备。那边要我10月12日前答复，所以想请您10月9日周五前给我一个结果。
note: 外部offer只提一次，语气平静，先说想留下；只有真的会去才提，否则就别拿它当筹码。

situation: Sous chef at a 30-seat restaurant, 3 years. Since our head chef left in June I've written the menus and done all the ordering, food cost went from 34% to 29%. I want the head chef title and $62k (I'm on $51k). Owner Marco runs everything; I want to text him to set up the talk.
reply: Hi Marco, could we sit down for 30 minutes before service this week, Wednesday or Thursday around 2? I'd like to talk about my role since June, with the menus and the ordering, and where it goes from here, including title and pay. I love this kitchen and want to keep building it with you, so I'd rather do this properly than mid-shift.
note: The booking text names the topic so it isn't an ambush; save the food-cost numbers and the $62k for the meeting itself.

situation: In March my manager Rob said if I delivered the data platform migration I'd be put up for Staff Engineer in the fall cycle. It went live on August 18. Now he says I also need to 'show more cross-org influence'. It feels like the goalposts moved. We have a 1:1 on Thursday.
reply: Thanks for being straight with me about where it stands. In March we agreed that shipping the data platform migration was the bar for Staff this fall, and it went live on 18 August. Since the criteria have shifted, could we write down exactly what's needed now, what cross-org influence looks like in practice, and the date you'll decide, so we're both working to the same list? I'd like it settled before November calibration.
note: Name the original agreement as a fact, not an accusation, and get the new bar in writing with a date. If it moves again, that tells you the ceiling here.

situation: 我在一家设计公司做了四年，今年三月开始带两个新人。上周刘总说给我升'设计组长'，但工资不变，明年再看。我现在月薪1.5万，公司其他组长大概1.8万。明天约了他谈。
reply: 刘总，谢谢您给我这个机会，组长这个角色我很想做好。从三月开始我已经在带小吴和小赵，他们的稿子都是我审，上个季度组里的准时交付率从80%提到了95%。升组长之后责任和范围都变了，我希望薪资同步调整到1.8万，和公司其他组长一致。如果现在调不了，我们能不能把条件和时间定下来，比如明年一月的调薪就按这个执行？
note: 晋升是头衔、职责加薪资；只给头衔时不要直接接受，先谈薪资，谈不下来就把条件和日期写下来。

situation: My new manager Aisha started six weeks ago and doesn't know my history. I'm a customer success lead on $64k; since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts (about $2.1M a year) with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses. I want $72k before the November review cycle. We meet Thursday.
reply: Thanks for making time, Aisha. I really like this team and want to keep growing here, and since you're new I wanted to give you the full picture before the November cycle. Since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts, about $2.1M a year, with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses now. Based on that scope and what CS leads are paid in the market, I'd like to move from $64,000 to $72,000. What would you need from me to make that case in November?
note: A new manager can't vouch for your history, so give her the case in numbers she can repeat upstairs, and send it in writing the same day.

situation: I've been a nanny for the Carters' two kids, Leo (8) and Maya (6), for two years at $20 an hour. Since September I also do school pickup and homework help, and Maya's reading has come on a lot. I want to ask their mum, Lucy, for $23 an hour from November. We've set up a chat Thursday evening.
reply: Lucy, I really love working with you and the kids and I'd like to keep doing it for a long time. Since September I've taken on school pickup and homework as well as childcare, and Maya has gone from struggling with reading to finishing a chapter book a week. Based on that and what nannies with this scope earn around here, I'd like to move to $23 an hour from November. What do you think, and if it's not possible now, what would it take?
note: A household employer is still an employer: commitment first, scope and results as evidence, one number, and an invitation to the path.

situation: 我在一家SaaS公司做测试工程师三年，月薪1.6万。上个月来了个同职级的新同事，我在带他熟悉系统，无意中知道他月薪1.9万。我查了招聘网站，同职级大概1.8万到2万。明天约了领导陈总谈，不想拿同事说事。
reply: 陈总，谢谢您抽时间。我很喜欢这里的工作，也想在测试这块继续做深。过去一年我搭了接口自动化测试，回归时间从两天缩到了半天；这个季度的新同事也是我在带。我看了一下，同职级测试工程师的市场薪资在1.8万到2万之间，我希望把月薪调到1.9万。如果现在调不了，需要满足哪些条件、什么时候能再看？
note: 同事的工资只是提醒你该谈了，不是论据；在谈话里只讲自己的成果、职级和市场数据，永远不点名比较。

situation: In August my manager Tom agreed my raise from $70k to $78k from September 1, and HR sent a confirmation letter on August 21. My September payslip still shows $70k, and Tom has said 'HR is on it' twice in two weeks. I want to follow up in writing without sounding pushy.
reply: Hi Tom, following up on my raise to $78,000 from 1 September, confirmed in HR's letter of 21 August. My September payslip still shows $70,000, so I was paid about $667 short before tax. Could you or HR confirm by Friday 2 October that the October payroll will include the new salary and the September back pay? Happy to forward the letter and the payslip if that helps.
note: Once a raise is agreed, the follow-up is admin: the letter, the gap, one dated ask. If October passes, go to HR directly with both documents.
